correctness.rationale: KKT affine-cell Jacobians are proved, and generic segment integration is valid for a continuous polyhedral projection. The cyclic zero-sum gradient transport generates interval indicators as the V-unit-ball tests. For A and interval I, the exact quotient (br+as)/(a+b) is verified via positive/negative component counts and separated-run boundary variation. The inequalities br+as<=2ab and br+as<=b(N-2b), with N=n+2, prove the exact floor/ceil bound for every integer n>=2. Distinct constructive run patterns for even/odd N attain equality, using actual projected input pairs in a common open active-set cell. Exact rational diagnostics check 115226 selector-interval cases and nine attaining pairs; finite checks are corroborative only.

value.rationale: Simplex projection is a standard nonlinear retraction in learning and imaging; when coordinates represent cyclically adjacent categories or phases, BV perturbation sensitivity is a natural quantity. The exact formula demonstrates linear-in-dimension two-input variation amplification despite one-input BV contraction, identifies n=4 as first strict amplification, proves actual sharp attainment in all dimensions, and quantifies residue-class arithmetic defects. This is a substantive stability boundary, not a single numerical computation or a renaming of the KKT formula.
